privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Learn how Bandmate collects, uses, and protects your personal information

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.text: Welcome to Bandmate. We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our service.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.text: We collect information that you provide directly to us when using Bandmate:

items.account: Account information: email address and authentication data from OAuth providers (Google, GitHub)
items.content: Content you create: songs, setlists, shows, band information, and related data
items.usage: Usage information: how you interact with the service, features used, and preferences

dataUse.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUse.text: We use the information we collect to:

items.service: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
items.communication: Send you important notifications about your account and service updates
items.improvement: Analyze usage patterns to enhance user experience and develop new features

dataSharing.title: Information Sharing
dataSharing.text: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only with band members you invite to collaborate, and with service providers who assist in operating our platform (such as Supabase for database and authentication services).

security.title: Data Security
security.text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information. This includes encryption of data in transit and at rest, secure authentication through OAuth providers, and regular security assessments.

cookies.title: Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.text: Bandmate uses local storage to remember your preferences (such as selected band and language settings) and to keep you logged in. We do not use tracking cookies or third-party analytics that track individual users.

items.access: Access the personal information we hold about you
items.deletion: Request deletion of your account and associated data
items.export: Export your data in a portable format

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us through our GitHub repository or the contact information provided in the application.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: Read the terms and conditions for using Bandmate

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.text: By accessing or using Bandmate, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our service.

serviceDescription.title: Description of Service
serviceDescription.text: Bandmate is a web-based platform that helps musicians manage their bands, songs, setlists, and shows. The service allows you to create and manage content, collaborate with band members, and organize your musical activities.

userAccounts.title: User Accounts
userAccounts.text: To use Bandmate, you must create an account using a supported OAuth provider (Google or GitHub). You are responsible for:

items.secure: Maintaining the security of your account credentials
items.responsible: All activities that occur under your account

userContent.title: User Content
userContent.text: You retain ownership of all content you create in Bandmate (songs, setlists, shows, etc.). By using the service, you grant us a limited license to store, display, and process your content solely to provide the service to you and your collaborators.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.text: When using Bandmate, you agree to:

items.lawful: Use the service only for lawful purposes
items.respectful: Respect other users and their content
items.noHarm: Not attempt to harm, disrupt, or exploit the service
items.noInfringe: Not upload content that infringes on intellectual property rights

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.text: The Bandmate platform, including its design, code, and branding, is owned by the Bandmate team. You may not copy, modify, or distribute our platform without permission. User-generated content remains the property of its creators.

termination.title: Termination
termination.text: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms or engage in behavior that harms other users or the service. You may also delete your account at any time through the application settings.

disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
disclaimers.text: Bandmate is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, secure, or error-free. We are not responsible for any loss of data, though we make reasonable efforts to maintain backups.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.text: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Bandmate and its team shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the service.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.text: We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. We will notify users of significant changes through the application or via email. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us through our GitHub repository or the contact information provided in the application.
